correctness.rationale: Fixed q-Frobenius diagonalizes on K=Fq⁴ in a Kummer eigenbasis. Each support I⊂{0,1,2,3} has (q−1)^(|I|−1) projective parameters and Frobenius orbit length e=4/gcd(4,i−j). The actual parameter field period r=4/gcd(4,i), giving right nucleus dimension 16/r from the skew polynomial commutator and known nucleus theorem; the automorphism norm criterion gives 4N/e. Exhausting all supports except central {0} yields exactly the five rows. Independent cyclic-projective exponent-orbit enumeration reproduced the frequency counts q=5,9,13, alongside direct Kummer-support arithmetic; these are finite checks of a symbolic proof depending on cited isomorphism and automorphism classification theorems.

The classification includes reducible skew polynomials/zero divisors and fixes the Frobenius generator; it is not a semifield or isotopy classification.
